scripts.dev: concurrently --names SERVER,CLIENT --prefix-colors blue,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently --names SERVER,CLIENT,HTTPS --prefix-colors blue,cyan,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run tunnel:https"
scripts.setup:docker: npm run db:start && npm run setup:local
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=server && npm install --workspace=client
